Description

Additional Okta application ID
AdditionalSsoApplicationIdentifier
Additional application identifier
AdditionalSsoApplicationUri
Additional application URI
AnomalousTicketContentClassification
Ticket signature analysis:
0x00000001: Irregular ticket usage time
0x00000002: Ticket signed with RC4 PAC
0x00000004: Unknown user mismatch
0x00000008: Ticket anomalous validity period
0x00000010: User SID mismatch in ticket
0x00000020: Ticket missing logon server
0x00000040: Rubeus Golden Ticket behavior
0x00000080: Impacket sapphire ticket
AttemptOutcome
Whether the exploitation attempt was successful:
True: successful
False: Identity Protection can't determine if it was successful
AzureApplicationId
Azure application ID
ContextTimeStamp
Time detected
CurrentPrivileges
A list of the source account's privileges at the time of the detection
DetectDescription
Description of identity-based detection
DetectId
Identity-based detection ID in Falcon
DetectName
Name of the identity-based detection
EndTime
Time of the last activity in identity-based detection
FalconHostLink
URL to the details view in Falcon
IdpPolicyRuleAction
A bit mask value of the Identity Protection policy rule action:
0x1 ALLOW - Allow the operation to proceed
0x2 BLOCK - Block the operation
0x4 MFA - Engage the user with an MFA challenge
0x8 RESET_PASSWORD - Reset the user's password
0x10 ADD_TO_WATCH_LIST - Add the user to the watch list
0x20 APPLY_SSO_POLICY - Add or remove the user from the SSO group in order to apply SSO
policies
IdpPolicyRuleName
Identity Protection policy rule name

6: PowerSploit (Get-DomainUser)
7: Rubeus (Kerberoasting)

12: Impacket (AdminCount)

14: AdFind
15: BloodHound (python)
16: SPN Enumeration
17: KrbRelay/KrbRelayUp
18: Certipy
19: Active Directory Certificate Services Reconnaissance Tools
20: Active Directory Certificate Services Enumeration
21: Active Directory Certificate Services Misconfiguration Enumeration
22: Rubeus (Golden Ticket)
23: ADRecon
24: Machine Learning

A list of the source account's privileges before privilege changes were made
ProtocolAnomalyClassification
Authentication signature analysis:
0x00000001: Protocol anomaly
0x00000002: Mimikatz
0x00000004: Metasploit
0x00000008: CrackMapExec/Impacket
0x00000010: Null hostname protocol field
0x00000020: Removed NetBIOS computer name protocol field
0x00000040: Duplicated EPA protocol fields
0x00000080: Duplicated AV Flags protocol field
0x00000100: Metasploit (new signature)
RpcOpClassification
RPC operation type:
1: Domain replication
2: SPN modification
3: Replication server registration
4: Scheduled task creation
5: Remote service configuration
6: Net session enumeration
7: User management (SAMR)
8: Remote SCM activation (DCOM)
9: Remote task management
10: Print system asynchronous remote protocol
11: Netlogon server authenticate
Severity
Identity-based detection severity number:
[0,19] - info
[20,39] - low
[40,59] - medium
[60,79] - high
[80,100] - critical
SeverityName
Identity-based detection severity name:
INFO
LOW
MEDIUM
HIGH
